@granary.addServer.address.description: Add-server screen: the label of the box the address is typed in.

@granary.addServer.addressPlaceholder.description: Add-server screen: the hint in the empty address box, two example addresses. Keep the addresses as they are.

granary.addServer.answersAsAnother: That server no longer answers as the one found. Try again.

@granary.addServer.answersAsAnother.description: Add-server screen: a server picked from those found nearby now answers with another server's identity.

@granary.addServer.cancelled.description: Add-server screen: the person cancelled connecting.

@granary.addServer.connect.description: Add-server screen: the button that connects to the typed address.

@granary.addServer.connecting.description: Add-server screen: the Connect button while it connects.

@granary.addServer.connectingTo.description: Add-server screen: progress once a Silo server answered. {address}: the server's address, such as https://silo.example.org.

@granary.addServer.found.description: Add-server screen: the server was found and saved; sign-in opens next. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.addServer.foundNearby.description: Add-server screen: the heading over the Silo servers found on this network.

granary.addServer.foundRowName: {name}, {detail}{unencrypted, select, true {, not encrypted} other {}}{connecting, select, true {, connecting} other {}}

@granary.addServer.foundRowName.description: Add-server screen: what a screen reader says for a server found nearby. {name}: the server's name; {detail}: the line under it (granary.addServer.onThisNetwork); unencrypted is true for a plain HTTP address; connecting is true while it connects.

granary.addServer.lead: Type the address you use for Silo.

@granary.addServer.lead.description: Add-server screen: the line under the title.

granary.addServer.needsSetup: This server still needs its first-time setup. Finish it in the server's web interface.

@granary.addServer.needsSetup.description: Add-server screen: the server answered but has not been set up yet.

granary.addServer.noServer: No Silo server answered at that address ({reason}).

@granary.addServer.noServer.description: Add-server screen: nothing at the typed address answered as a Silo server. {reason}: a short technical reason in English, such as timeout or HTTP 404.

granary.addServer.notAnAddress: That is not a server address.

@granary.addServer.notAnAddress.description: Add-server screen: what was typed cannot be an address.

@granary.addServer.notEncrypted.description: Add-server screen: under a server found nearby, whose address is plain HTTP.

@granary.addServer.onThisNetwork.description: Add-server screen: the line under a server found nearby. {address}: its address and port, such as 192.168.1.6:8090.

@granary.addServer.opening.description: Add-server screen: the address is a saved server that is still signed in, so it opens again. {name}: the server's name.

granary.addServer.saveFailed: Granary could not save the server. Try again.

@granary.addServer.saveFailed.description: Add-server screen: the server was found but could not be saved on this PC.

granary.addServer.title: Connect to your Silo server

@granary.addServer.title.description: Add-server screen: its title, beside Silo's mark.

@granary.addServer.trying.description: Add-server screen: progress while one of the addresses the typed one may mean is tried. {address}: that address.

granary.addServer.updateRequired: This Silo server is too old for this app. Update the server and try again.

@granary.addServer.updateRequired.description: Add-server screen: the server only speaks an API Granary no longer uses.

granary.apiFailure.busy: The server is busy, try again.

@granary.apiFailure.busy.description: After a call the server answered as busy (503): the profile picker, a PIN check, a title's page, starting playback.

granary.apiFailure.tooManyRequests: {count, plural, one {The server is receiving too many requests. Try again in # minute.} other {The server is receiving too many requests. Try again in # minutes.}}

@granary.apiFailure.tooManyRequests.description: The server asks to wait before the next request (429). count: the minutes to wait.

granary.apiFailure.tooManyRequestsLater: The server is receiving too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.

@granary.apiFailure.tooManyRequestsLater.description: The server asks to wait before the next request (429) without saying how long.

granary.apiFailure.unexpected: The server sent an answer this app does not understand.

@granary.apiFailure.unexpected.description: Something answered that is not the Silo server Granary expects, for example a proxy's page.

granary.apiFailure.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.apiFailure.unreachable.description: The server could not be reached at all.

@granary.auth.tagline.description: Add-server and sign-in screens: the line under Granary's name. Silo is the server's name; keep it.

@granary.card.new.description: A card's badge on a title new to the library. Shown in capitals.

@granary.card.progress.description: What a screen reader says for the bar along a card's foot that shows how much of the title was watched.

@granary.card.resetProgress.description: A card's ⋮ menu: clears where the viewer left off in the title, without marking it watched.

@granary.forYou.loading.description: For You: what a screen reader says for the spinner while the rows load.

@granary.home.empty.description: Home: the heading when no row has anything for this profile yet.

granary.home.emptyHint: Rows appear here once this server has something for the profile.

@granary.home.emptyHint.description: Home: the line under granary.home.empty. The server decides which rows Home shows.

@granary.home.loading.description: Home: what shows, and a screen reader says, while Home's rows load.

granary.loadError.denied: This profile isn't allowed to see this.

@granary.loadError.denied.description: Under a page or row that could not load because the server refused this profile (401 or 403). Granary's own: the web has no text for it.

@granary.loadError.gone.description: Under a page or row that could not load because the server no longer has it (404). Granary's own: the web has no text for it.

granary.profiles.changed: That profile has changed. Choose it again.

@granary.profiles.changed.description: Profile picker: the profile lost its PIN or was removed while its PIN was checked; the list was read again.

granary.profiles.empty: This account has no profiles yet.

@granary.profiles.empty.description: Profile picker: the account has no profile to pick.

granary.profiles.listFailed: The server could not list the profiles (error {status}).

@granary.profiles.listFailed.description: Profile picker: the server refused to list the profiles. {status}: the HTTP status, such as 500.

@granary.profiles.loading.description: Profile picker: what a screen reader says for the spinner while the profiles load.

@granary.profiles.noServer.description: Profile picker: no server is in use, so there are no profiles to show.

granary.profiles.openFailed: Could not open the profile. Try again.

@granary.profiles.openFailed.description: Profile picker: the picked profile could not be opened.

granary.profiles.pin.allDigits: {count, plural, one {Enter the # digit of the PIN.} other {Enter all # digits of the PIN.}}

@granary.profiles.pin.allDigits.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: fewer digits were entered than a PIN has. count: the PIN's length, 4.

granary.profiles.pin.checkFailed: The PIN could not be checked (error {status}).

@granary.profiles.pin.checkFailed.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: the server refused the check. {status}: the HTTP status, such as 500.

granary.profiles.pin.description: This profile is protected by a 4-digit PIN.

@granary.profiles.pin.description.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: the line over the PIN box. The fourth digit sends the PIN, so there is no button.

@granary.profiles.pin.titleNoName.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: its title for a moment while it closes, when the profile's name is gone. With the name it is the web's Enter PIN for {name}.

granary.profiles.pin.unconfirmed: The server did not confirm the PIN. Try again.

@granary.profiles.pin.unconfirmed.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: the server called the PIN right but sent nothing to open the profile with.

@granary.recommendations.loadingTitles.description: A For You row in full: what a screen reader says for the spinner while its titles load.

granary.search.allInLibrary: Every title found so far is already in your library.

@granary.search.allInLibrary.description: Search, under Request to add: TMDB found titles, but the library has all of them. Granary gathers TMDB's pages in one grid, so this speaks of all found so far.

granary.search.busy: Search is busy, try again in a moment

@granary.search.busy.description: Search: the server answered that its search is busy (503).

@granary.search.loadingMoreRequests.description: Search, under Request to add: what a screen reader says for the spinner while TMDB's next page loads.

granary.section.gone: This row is no longer available.

@granary.section.gone.description: Explore all of a row: the row was removed from Home or its library page meanwhile.

@granary.section.loading.description: Explore all of a row: what shows, and a screen reader says, while its titles load. {title}: the row's name, such as Continue Watching.

@granary.servers.active.description: Server list: the badge on the server Granary uses now.

@granary.servers.add.description: Server list: the button that opens the add-server screen.

@granary.servers.details.description: Server list: the line under the active server's name. {address}: its address; {name}: the signed-in account's username.

granary.servers.empty: No servers yet. Add a Silo server to get started.

@granary.servers.empty.description: Server list: shown when no server is saved.

granary.servers.error.busy: {name} is busy. Wait a moment and try again.

@granary.servers.error.busy.description: Server list: the server answered that it gets too many requests (429). {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.error.refused.description: Server list: the server refused to switch, sign out or remove. {name}: the server's name; {code}: the server's problem code in English, such as session_expired.

granary.servers.error.serverProblem: {name} has a problem right now. Try again later.

@granary.servers.error.serverProblem.description: Server list: the server answered with an error of its own (5xx). {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.error.settings: Granary could not save its settings on this computer. Try again.

@granary.servers.error.settings.description: Server list: the list of servers could not be written on this PC.

granary.servers.error.signInData: Granary could not read or save its sign-in data on this computer.

@granary.servers.error.signInData.description: Server list: the sign-in kept on this PC could not be read or written.

granary.servers.error.timeout: {name} did not answer in time. Try again.

@granary.servers.error.timeout.description: Server list: the server took too long to answer. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.error.unexpected: {name} sent an answer Granary does not understand. Check the server address.

@granary.servers.error.unexpected.description: Server list: something at the server's address answered, but not as a Silo server. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.error.unreachable: Could not reach {name}. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.servers.error.unreachable.description: Server list: the server could not be reached. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.moreOptions.description: Server list: the tooltip of a server's … button, which opens Sign out and Remove.

@granary.servers.moreOptionsFor.description: Server list: what a screen reader says for a server's … button. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.remove.description: Server list: the menu item that removes a server; it asks first.

granary.servers.removeDialog.body: Granary signs out of this server and forgets it. You can add it again later.

@granary.servers.removeDialog.body.description: Server list: the question before a server is removed.

@granary.servers.removeDialog.confirm.description: Server list: the button that removes the server, in the question before it.

granary.servers.removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?

@granary.servers.removeDialog.title.description: Server list: the title of the question before a server is removed. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.removed.description: Server list: the server was signed out of and removed. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.removedUnconfirmed: Removed {name}. The server did not confirm the sign-out.

@granary.servers.removedUnconfirmed.description: Server list: the server was removed, but could not be reached to sign out. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.signedInAs.description: Server list: under the active server. {name}: the signed-in account's username.

@granary.servers.signedOut.description: Server list: Sign out on a server worked. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.switch.description: Server list: the button that makes a server the one Granary uses.

@granary.servers.switchTo.description: Server list: what a screen reader says for the Switch button. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.title: Servers

@granary.servers.title.description: Server list: its title. The list holds the Silo servers saved in Granary.

@granary.servers.working.description: Server list: what a screen reader says for the spinner while a server is switched, signed out of or removed.

@granary.shell.backTooltip.description: The tooltip of the round back button at a page's top left. Alt+Left is the keyboard shortcut; name the keys as the keyboard does in the language.

@granary.shell.close.description: In full screen, the title bar's button that closes Granary's window, as Windows' own Close.

@granary.shell.exitFullScreen.description: The title bar's button that takes the window out of full screen.

@granary.shell.exitFullScreenTooltip.description: The tooltip of the title bar's button that takes the window out of full screen. F11 is the keyboard shortcut.

@granary.shell.fullScreen.description: The title bar's button, beside Windows' own, that puts the whole window in full screen.

@granary.shell.fullScreenTooltip.description: The tooltip of the title bar's full-screen button. F11 is the keyboard shortcut.

@granary.shell.notificationsUnread.description: What a screen reader says for the sidebar's Notifications while some are unread. count: how many.

@granary.shell.searchTooltip.description: The tooltip of the sidebar's Search. Ctrl+K is the keyboard shortcut; name the keys as the keyboard does in the language.

@granary.shell.starting.description: What a screen reader says for Granary's animated mark while the app starts.

granary.signIn.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.

@granary.signIn.busy.description: Sign-in: the server answered that it is busy (503).

@granary.signIn.device.code.description: Sign-in: what a screen reader adds to the code shown under the QR code, which is typed on another device.

@granary.signIn.device.newCode.description: Sign-in: the button under the QR code once it was declined or did not work; it shows a new code.

@granary.signIn.device.panel.description: Sign-in: what a screen reader says for the box with the QR code and the code.

granary.signIn.device.qrImage: QR code to sign in. Scan it with your phone's camera.

@granary.signIn.device.qrImage.description: Sign-in: what a screen reader says for the QR code image.

granary.signIn.device.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Trying again shortly…

@granary.signIn.device.tooManyRequests.description: Sign-in with a code: the server asks to slow down; Granary keeps asking on its own.

granary.signIn.device.unavailable: This server does not offer sign-in with a code. Use your password.

@granary.signIn.device.unavailable.description: Sign-in with a code: the server has no sign-in with a code; only the password form works.

granary.signIn.device.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Still trying…

@granary.signIn.device.unreachable.description: Sign-in with a code: the server cannot be reached for a while; Granary keeps trying on its own.

@granary.signIn.device.validUntil.description: Sign-in: under the code, until when it works. {time}: a time of day, such as 14:05.

@granary.signIn.deviceOnly.description: Sign-in: the heading over the QR code when the server has no password sign-in, so the code is the only way. With password sign-in the heading is the web's Use your phone instead.

@granary.signIn.failed.description: Sign-in: the server refused in a way Granary has no words for. {status}: the HTTP status, such as 500.

granary.signIn.passwordDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this server. Sign in with the code instead.

@granary.signIn.passwordDisabled.description: Sign-in: the server refused the password because password sign-in is off; the QR code below still works.

granary.signIn.serverGone: This server is no longer saved. Add it again.

@granary.signIn.serverGone.description: Sign-in: the server to sign in to was removed meanwhile.

granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.inAMinute: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.

@granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.inAMinut.description: Sign-in: too many attempts; the server asks to wait a minute at most.

granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.later: Too many attempts. Try again later.

@granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.later.description: Sign-in: too many attempts; the server did not say how long to wait.

granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.minutes: {count, plural, one {Too many attempts. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many attempts. Try again in # minutes.}}

@granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.minutes.description: Sign-in: too many attempts; the server asks to wait. count: the minutes, two or more.

@granary.signIn.unencrypted.accept.description: Sign-in: the button that agrees to sign in over a connection that is not encrypted.

granary.signIn.unencrypted.body: The server address starts with http://. Your password and sign-in would be readable by others on the network.

@granary.signIn.unencrypted.body.description: Sign-in: why a plain HTTP connection is a risk. Keep http:// as it is.

granary.signIn.unencrypted.title: This connection is not encrypted

@granary.signIn.unencrypted.title.description: Sign-in: the heading of the warning shown for a server at a plain HTTP address.

granary.signIn.unexpectedAnswer: {name} answered in a way Granary does not understand. Check the server address.

@granary.signIn.unexpectedAnswer.description: Sign-in: something at the server's address answered, but not as a Silo server. {name}: the server's name.

granary.signIn.unreachable: Can't reach {name}. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.signIn.unreachable.description: Sign-in: the server could not be reached. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.signIn.wrongCredentials.description: Sign-in: the server refused the username and password (401).

@granary.update.later.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary: the button that closes the notice; the update installs when Granary closes.

@granary.update.notice.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary, at the window's bottom right. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

granary.update.noticeHint: Restart now, or it installs when you close Granary.

@granary.update.noticeHint.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary: the line under its title.

@granary.update.restartNow.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary: the button that restarts Granary into the new version.
